domain-information: A Cinema Manager selects upcoming films and assigns them to available auditoriums.
A Cinema Manager reviews attendance data during screenings to adjust future film schedules.
A Cinema Manager approves staffing plans created by the shift supervisor.
A Shift Supervisor prepares a screening schedule for projection staff.
A Shift Supervisor creates a staffing plan to assign clerks to concession and ticket stations.
A Shift Supervisor logs operational issues to report back to the cinema manager.
A Projectionist loads the scheduled film into the projection system.
A Projectionist checks the auditorium equipment to ensure the movie starts without interruptions.
A Projectionist reports equipment malfunctions to the shift supervisor for escalation.
A Concession Clerk restocks snack inventory to prepare for the evening rush.
A Concession Clerk records inventory shortages so the procurement team can place orders.
A Ticketing Clerk sells customers tickets for a screening according to schedule supervisor.
A Ticketing Clerk processes a refund request.

associations.description: Cinema Manager assigns films to Auditorium.
Cinema Manager adjusts Screening based on performance.
Shift Supervisor creates the Staffing Plan.
Cinema Manager approves the Staffing Plan.
Shift Supervisor prepares the Screening Schedule.
Shift Supervisor logs an Operational Issue Report.
Operational Issue Report is sent to Cinema Manager.
Projectionist loads films into the Projection System.
Projectionist submits an Equipment Malfunction Report.
Equipment Malfunction Report is forwarded to Shift Supervisor.
Ticketing Clerk processes the Refund Request.
Concession Clerk creates a Shortage Report.
Shortage Report is sent to Procurement Team.
